items.title: Floral Blessings Lantern
items.alt: A rose-gold lantern with an unlit candle carries a “BLESSINGS” tag beside peach roses and green foliage.
items.description: The faceted glass body and full curved handle give the floral lantern a tall, complete gift-object silhouette.

items.title: Blessings Patchwork Quilt Gift
items.alt: A folded coral, navy and cream quilt is tied with a cotton ribbon reading “BLESSINGS.”
items.description: Stitched hearts, a star, leaves and a small house make the individual fabric patches easy to distinguish.

items.title: Sending Blessings Lavender Card
items.alt: An open lilac envelope holds a cream “SENDING BLESSINGS” card with lavender stems and a purple butterfly.
items.description: A tied natural-colored cord gathers the flower spray beside the gold-edged card and complete envelope flap.

items.title: Grow Blessings Seedling Planter
items.alt: A green seedling grows in a terracotta pot beside a wooden “GROW BLESSINGS” marker, seed packet and trowel.
items.description: Broad glossy leaves rise above dark soil, with the full silver tool and blank packet arranged along the pot’s base.

items.title: Blessed Floral Bookmark on a Book
items.alt: An embroidered cream bookmark reading “BLESSED” lies diagonally across a closed burgundy book.
items.description: Blue flowers and green leaves run along the bookmark beside its complete navy tassel and the book’s pale page edges.

items.title: Many Blessings Star Character
items.alt: A smiling yellow cartoon star holds a cream “MANY BLESSINGS” card while wearing a purple bow tie and sneakers.
items.description: Freckled cheeks, white gloves and striped socks give the full five-pointed character a playful greeting-card pose.
